map.压力性损伤按 NPIAP/EPUAP 分期判读：1 期 = 指压不变白的红斑；2: Pressure injury staged by NPIAP/EPUAP: Stage 1 = non-blanchable erythema; Stage 2 = partial-thickness loss or serous blister; Stage 3 = full-thickness skin loss with visible fat not to fascia; Stage 4 = full-thickness tissue loss with exposed fascia/muscle/bone; Unstageable = wound covered by eschar, judge after debridement; Deep tissue injury = persistent non-blanchable purple/maroon area. Item count n = min(max(input, 1), 6), randomly drawing n of the six stages; n=6 covers all six.
map.每次最多生成 6 条，对应 6 个分期各一条，顺序随机；填 6 时覆盖全部六期。: At most 6 items per run, one per stage, in random order; enter 6 to cover all six stages.
map.记录 1 期（非苍白性红斑）与 2 期（部分皮层缺损）的区别描述。: Record the difference between Stage 1 (non-pale erythema) and Stage 2 (partial-thickness loss).
map.3–4 期按组织丢失深度与坏死范围生成结构化描述。: Stages 3-4 generate structured descriptions by tissue-loss depth and necrosis extent.
map.可疑深部组织损伤与不可分期按覆盖物特征标注。: Suspected deep tissue injury and unstageable are marked by covering features.
map.生成数量填 6，工具从 1 期、2 期、3 期、4 期、不可分期、深部组织损伤六: With count 6, the tool generates one item for each of Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3, Stage 4, Unstageable and Deep tissue injury (random order). Each item includes presentation and care points, covering all stages in one record; counts above 6 are capped at 6.
map.本工具能替代医师诊断吗？: Can this tool replace the physician's diagnosis?
map.不能，仅作描述模板，分期以创面专科评估为准。: No; it is a description template. Staging follows wound-specialist assessment.
map.1 期与 2 期如何区分？: How to tell Stage 1 from Stage 2?
map.1 期皮肤完整红斑不退，2 期已破损达真皮，关键看皮肤完整性。: Stage 1: intact skin with non-fading erythema; Stage 2: broken to dermis. Key is skin integrity.
map.深部组织损伤为何难判？: Why is deep tissue injury hard to judge?
map.表皮可完好但皮下已坏死，需持续观察颜色、温度、硬度变化。: Epidermis may be intact while subcutaneous tissue is necrotic; keep watching color, temperature and firmness.
map.按 NPUAP 分期生成压力性损伤描述文本，辅助护理记录。: Generates NPUAP-stage pressure-injury description text to aid nursing records.
